description: On-demand, evidence-led subculture making, participation, performance, play and community-documentary taxonomy. Public sources inform only abstract dimensions; no source prose, images, real identities, logos or character designs are copied.

scene_action_templates: sharing, testing, displaying, or performing the result of {action} with the relevant community
handling the immediate wear, repair, care, exchange, or closeout after {action}

evidence_budget.guidance: one embodied practice phase, one physical practice prop, and at most one additional community or material clue
